prompt: I have a tendency to keep browser tabs open. I currently have over 200 of them open at this time. What could I do to avoid keeping so many tabs open at all time?
response: Keeping numerous tabs open is a common habit, and it's fine to let them accumulate as long as you can manage them. You don't necessarily need to close them; just make sure you have enough RAM to handle them. If you need to find a specific tab, using the Ctrl+Tab function can help you switch between them quickly.
